references.text: Jesus had just instructed the disciples to untie the colt and what they should say if anyone asked—in [ref:Luk 19:30-31|Luke 19:30-31] Jesus gives the exact instruction that the disciples now follow, and the owners' question is exactly what Jesus predicted.

The parallel account in [ref:Mark 11:5-6|Mark 11:5-6] describes the same event: some of those standing there asked what they were doing as they untied the colt, and the disciples answered just as Jesus had said.
In [ref:Matt 21:6|Matthew 21:6], it is told that the disciples went and did as Jesus had commanded them, which includes this event of fetching the donkey and the colt.

In [ref:Luk 19:34|Luke 19:34], the disciples give the answer Jesus had instructed them to give: "The Lord needs it." This is the direct continuation showing that Jesus' words in verse 31 were fulfilled.
In [ref:Mark 11:3|Mark 11:3] Jesus gives the parallel instruction about what the disciples should say if anyone asks why they are untying the colt—the same situation that arises here in Luke 19:33.
